title: Not Thrown About
logline: At a fish-landing site before dawn, a gutter and sorter handles the day's catch, however it arrives, without flinching or lingering, and talks plainly about how they got used to work most people turn away from.
human_question: What is the difference between not caring and simply not being thrown off balance by what you meet?

premise.story: A worker at a fish-landing or fish-market site (or a similar site of work others find unpleasant) does their daily, skilled, unglamorous work with evident steadiness.
premise.place: A fish-landing site, market or similar workplace.
premise.experience: Close observation of steady, competent handling of repulsive or difficult tasks, without commentary, and the worker's own account of how they got that way.

concept_links.why: Among ten kinds described, from the most spectacular to the most ordinary, the source names one power that belongs only to the fully freed: dwelling without revulsion towards the repulsive, without attraction to the alluring, and evenly towards both [C090-P4:L85–L87; C090-M:L13]. The film watches an ordinary, human-scale form of that steadiness, and must never suggest the worker has any such attainment.

The source is clear that no special ability arises just from wishing, and separately ranks readiness under pressure as the hardest use of any power; the worker's daily composure is offered only as an echo, not an instance.

what_camera_could_observe: The pre-dawn arrival of the catch, sorting and gutting
The worker's manner with customers and colleagues
A difficult or unpleasant moment handled without fuss
Breaks, and what the worker says, in their own words, about the work
what_must_be_real: The worker's real job and real account of themselves. No claim of any inner attainment is made or implied.

possible_arc.turn: A particularly unpleasant or difficult task.
possible_arc.ending_open: The worker's own reflection on the work, however they choose to give it.

requirements: A willing worker at a real fish-landing site or similar workplace
Full consent and dignity throughout, without exploiting low-status labour

suggestions.name: Peliyagoda fish market
suggestions.why: A large, well-known wholesale fish market.
suggestions.access_notes: Very early hours; market management permission needed.
suggestions.verify: A specific willing worker must be identified.

risks: Exploiting low-status or difficult labour for a spiritual message
The worker becoming a symbol rather than a full person
Gore or sensationalism in the imagery
drop_if: No worker will consent to be filmed and interviewed with dignity, on their own terms

connections.note: From the boat that carries people across, to the community that lands and sells what the sea gives.
Two ordinary, unstaged forms of steadiness the sources call 'power': one under unpleasant routine, one under sudden danger.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
